description: 7 standalone X posts · growth week starting 2026-07-13. Nikita Bier rule: one unexpected insight, ≤5 sentences, subject monopoly = human-verified Bitcoin circular economy + live instruments as proof. Soft link only when the page is evidence. Post one per day. Attach a short clip/screenshot when noted. Nostr: strip @tags, use hashtags.
tweets:
Most Bitcoin sites teach you to hold.

Almost none help you spend without feeling like you sold the bottom.

A merchant directory only works if every shop is re-checked by a human, not scraped forever.

galaxymind.space

People will ignore a 10-signal market model written as a blog.

They will stare at a 0–100 gauge if the needle moves.

That is why the Buying Gauge exists · not more content, a dial.

galaxymind.space/stack

The rarest Bitcoin is not unmined.

It is the coins still free to buy after lost, held, ETFs, governments, and treasuries take their cut.

Watch that number fall and price starts making a different kind of sense.

galaxymind.space/float

A public company can hold more Bitcoin than you and still be the worse buy.

If the stock trades above the coins after debt and prefs, you are paying a tax for the story.

If it trades under, the market is selling you residual exposure cheap.

galaxymind.space/treasuries

Wordle proved people will return for a 30-second puzzle.

Bitcoin Twitter already has the tape.

WEN is just that: a real 90-day slice of price with the dates ripped off. One puzzle a day.

galaxymind.space/wen

I built a free Super Mario-style game through Bitcoin history so the lore stops living only in threads.

21 levels. Peter Schiff is the final boss. Daily Summit is the mountain everyone races today.

galaxymind.space/super-saylor

If your “circular economy” is three coffee shops and a podcast, it is a cosplay.

124 human-verified merchants across 20 countries is still early · and that is the point.

Find one to spend with this week.

galaxymind.space
